mapper.insert: insert into comment (spu_id, user_id, content, images, rating, status, create_time) values (#{spuId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{images}, #{rating}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update comment set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select c.id, c.spu_id as spuId, c.user_id as userId, u.name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, c.content, c.images, c.rating, c.create_time as createTime from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.spu_id = #{spuId} and c.status = 1 order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.spu_id as spuId, s.name as spuName, sk.image as spuImage, c.content, c.images, c.rating, c.create_time as createTime from comment c left join shoe_spu s on c.spu_id = s.id left join shoe_sku sk on sk.spu_id = s.id and sk.is_default = 1 where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.status = 1 order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc
